Recording Mode allows you to directly record videos cached on a video page.

Cons

  • Occasional issues with missing video or audio segments.

t2_superRecorderInjectJsBtnTip.message:
Capture mode allows you to capture videos from web pages, making it easy to save your favorites.

Pros

  • Captures most videos(Except for videos protected by copyright.).

Cons

  • Large file sizes.
  • No fast-forward when capturing.
  • Relatively high hardware requirements, may experience lagging. (You can reduce the resolution of the target video being recorded to lessen the lagging.)
